protocol.scope: CPU-only synthetic fixed-trajectory math and calibration-cost prototype; no model, GPU, or real TRAIN/DEV/TEST tensors
protocol.tolerance_basis: Conservative FP64 tolerance fixed before results: at most 128 recurrence reductions on small synthetic dimensions; not a rigorous native FP32 roundoff certificate
protocol.coverage_rule: Record per-stage and simultaneous all-stage/head/row score interval coverage; Bonferroni alpha divided by three stages and every head/row; do not retune alpha or choose seeds from results
protocol.bias_rule: Report mean Khat/exact K and sample standard error across all128 frozen probe seeds, with per-row and pooled summaries; finite-sample deviation is not a proof of bias/unbiasedness
protocol.subsample_scope: Uniform scored-output subsampling with inverse-inclusion weights and unchanged source writes/transitions; exact shared c computed separately; no claim of time matching until observed costs are compared
protocol.cost_rule: Compare complete calibration calls including exact c and probe generation; report measured CPU wall/CPU time and array working-set estimates separately; no runtime-serving speedup or real-trace collection cost claim
protocol.GPU_expansion: NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_PROTOTYPE_ALONE: requires representative real three-layer pilot advantage over exact chunking and equal-cost subsampling in root protocol
